Agenda
Item 1
CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term

The committee considered the CEO Succession Plan Review — Emergency & Long-Term, a proposal to adopt a new policy on the use of social media by employees. The policy was approved and will be included in the employee handbook.

Item 2
Independent Director Session: Board Effectiveness

The regular quarterly review of the Independent Director Session: Board Effectiveness was led by Reynaldo Lang. The data presented in Exhibit B showed performance to be on track with the 1998 operating plan. The committee acknowledged the positive progress and accepted the report as filed, with no further action required at this time.

Motion

To approve for stakeholder capitalism: RESOLVED, that the Regional Executive Committee - Latin America shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Sebastian Whitehead  •  Seconded: Kaarina Weber
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1998

The Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1998 was a review of the company's compliance with the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA). The committee reviewed the results of a recent internal audit, which found no material weaknesses.

Motion

To approve for acquisition: RESOLVED, that the Regional Executive Committee - Latin America hereby approves the Technology Roadmap and Investment Plan for FY1998 as presented, effective 1998-03-07, and authorizes the designated owner to take all actions necessary to implement the foregoing.

Moved: Omar Murray  •  Seconded: Sebastian Whitehead
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report

The committee considered the Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report, a proposal to adopt a new policy on intellectual property. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To approve for KPI: RESOLVED, that the Regional Executive Committee - Latin America adopts the revised Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report policy, which shall supersede all prior policies on this matter, effective immediately.

Moved: Reynaldo Lang  •  Seconded: Sebastian Whitehead
Vote: 6 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
